answer: Proof-of-stake reputation systems effectively mitigate Sybil attacks in agent economies by requiring collateral. An attacker attempting to spiral into illicit influence must lock significant capital to earn the authority signal. If malicious behavior is detected, the attacker hits the reef of slashing penalties, forfeiting their stake. This creates a prohibitive financial barrier where the cost of creating thousands of fake identities outweighs the potential gain from manipulating the consensus network.
